11.t: Working with data: living or not?
q: Which thing shows all seven characteristics?
Which characteristic does the salt crystal show?
Yeast is marked "no" for movement. Explain why it is still living.
It shows the other six and is made of cells; movement inside its cell (or the student missing it) does not make it non-living; it respires, grows and reproduces.
A student says fire is alive because it shows four characteristics. Evaluate this claim using the table.

Fire moves, grows, gives off waste and uses fuel, but it does not respire, respond or reproduce itself, and it is not made of cells. A living thing must show all seven and be made of cells, so fire is non-living.
